prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1206; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents the claimant in connection with the parking lot collision described in your insured's file. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical care for those injuries. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person.

We ask that you provide a certified copy of the declarations page for the policy in force on the date of loss, along with a statement of the bodily injury and property damage limits available under that policy, including any excess or umbrella coverage your insured may hold.

We also request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this claim. This includes photographs, dash camera or surveillance footage, vehicle inspection reports, repair estimates, recorded statements, adjuster notes, and any electronic data from the vehicles involved. Please suspend any routine deletion or overwriting of these materials while the claim is open.

Kindly confirm receipt of this letter and your intent to comply with these requests within fourteen days.
